attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; Google Drive API v3 publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Google Drive API v3, converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document (revision 20260629) committed as upstream.json. Every resource method (64 operations) and every Discovery schema (54 components) is modelled. The googledrive adaptor calls this API through the googleapis SDK; the whole API is described here (not just the adaptor's operations) so a workflow can reach any endpoint via the generic builders.
